title: Trump Says He Will Call Putin Over Russia's Pneumonic Plague Outbreak
detail: US President Trump announced he intends to call Russian President Putin regarding the pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia, elevating the public health crisis to a diplomatic issue. Analysts note the move has both public health and geopolitical dimensions, as international pressure mounts on Moscow to share more information about the outbreak's scope.

media.caption: Trump announces call with Putin over pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia

title: Kremlin Condemns France's Nuclear Missile Test, Calls Anti-Russia Strategy 'Dead End'
detail: The Kremlin sharply condemned France after it tested a nuclear-capable ballistic missile, with Russian officials calling France's anti-Russia strategy a 'dead end.' The test signals a hardening European nuclear deterrence posture amid the ongoing conflict in Ukraine, drawing Moscow's ire as Western nations move to bolster their own nuclear capabilities independent of NATO.

media.caption: Kremlin condemns France's nuclear-capable missile test as European deterrence posture hardens

title: Russia on Track to Spend $199 Billion on Ukraine War in 2026
detail: A new analysis finds the Kremlin is on pace to spend $199 billion on the Ukraine war in 2026, underscoring the escalating fiscal burden of the conflict. The figure reflects soaring military expenditures as Russia continues its full-scale invasion, with defense spending now consuming an unprecedented share of the federal budget and straining the broader Russian economy.
